court.name: The Folded Court
court.blurb: Versatile and balanced — no glaring weakness.
court.trait: Formation: units take LESS damage the more allies stand with them. Fight as a tight block.

foldshade.name: Foldshade
foldshade.desc: Cloaked raider — unseen without enemy detection.

ember.name: The Ember Bindery
ember.blurb: Aggressive glass cannon — cheap, fast, fragile, burns.
ember.trait: Aggro: cheap fast units that BURN foes over time and COMBUST on death. Punish clumps.

cinderwraith.name: Cinderwraith
cinderwraith.desc: Cloaked raider — unseen without enemy detection.

scriptorium.desc: Town hall. Trains Pearlscribes; ink drop-off.

deepstalker.name: Deepstalker
deepstalker.desc: Cloaked raider — unseen without enemy detection.

press.blurb: Relentless printing-house — units wind up, hitting harder the longer they stay on a target.

objects.desc: Hold the centre for a slow ink bounty.

creases.name: The Creases
creases.desc: Square & compact. Fast fights, short rushes.

spine.desc: A long horizontal corridor — a lane to hold or break.

objects.desc: The prize in the middle of the pass.

corners.name: Four Corners
corners.desc: A large square with rich corners far from home.

sliver.name: Paper Sliver
sliver.desc: Thin & tense. Little room; expect early aggression.

crown.name: The Crown Fold
crown.desc: A central plateau crowns the map. Take the high ground.

objects.label: Crown Well
objects.desc: The richest prize, atop the plateau.

objects.label: The Crown
objects.desc: Hold the summit for a steady bounty.

seam.desc: A long corridor pinched by two chokepoints. Hold the gaps.
